reviews.comment: Took Prof. McCartney's class - it's challenging, but the in-class practice and unstuckstudy ai were super helpful for exam prep. Definitely attend lectures and use all resources.

Doc Mac is an amazing professor, knows what she is doing, she is kind and gives excellent feedback. Go to her office hours for any questions and she will walk you through any issues you have in your homework, lab or any questions about lecture. She is really funny too! Her memes made my day. She is an AMAZING prof, please take her class.

Truth be told, until recently, I would have given this professor a 3.5, however, this professor does have her moments. The class is homework and test-heavy, tests are hard but exactly like the mock exams. However, she does have a big personality. I lost trust in her judgment since she is mostly stubborn and she can be rude and inconsiderate.
Had her for a summer course. She did very well with the smaller lecture size. Don't know if her style would translate well for a large lecture.

A compassionate and effective professor. Great lectures and was available and fantastic for feedback. Makes class the right amount of difficult but never painful. She gives you everything needed but expects you to do the work required. Homework is heavy, iclicker is essential, and studying before class will become more necessary as course goes on.

Got a little more moody and was out of class a bit more from 119, but still kept it pretty fair. 120 is simply harder than 119 which is probably what people are upset over combined with her absences, but she actually gave extra credit this time. Study harder than you did in 119 and you'll be fine. Lab is harder too so be ready for practical.

Good Chem 119 class, if you work well with a very structured class you'll be fine. Consistent, regular due dates for everything and a schedule set way ahead of time. I liked the flipped class design bc I could understand everything before class and then just practice in class. Not much ec, but very fair grading and lots of room to get points.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HER FOR CHEM 120! Thought she was pretty good for 119 so I took 120 with her. Huge mistake. She turned into a completely different person treating us like we were in grade school, then went on vacation for 2 weeks at the end of the semester. The exams are 50% conceptual, nothing like the mock exams, practice questions or homework.

Came and listened to every lecture, spent >15 hrs a wk on this class, studied for hours, and hated Doc Mac's attitude and treatment of her students the entire semester. Spent most of the sem. at an 85-89, finished with an A and a broad understanding of all concepts. Watch the lecture vids before class - she uses the class to do 3-5 problems.

Pretty good in 119 and gets you a solid understanding of chemistry there, but then baits you into taking her 120 class where she just makes the tests conceptually hard on top of the immense amount of math you need to know how to do. In addition to lab and the aleks hw, this class is gonna make you have no time to do anything out of school

professors should be caring and understanding and actually teach. she doesnt fall under any of those categories. seems like she just wants to get in & out of class, make her money, and go home. exams were ridiculously hard for no reason & the aleks hw was insufferable. so glad this class is over & done with because i could not deal w it any longer
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She does flipped lecture which is a little annoying, but otherwise it was convenient being able to watch the videos again if needed. She does clicker problems everyday, so you have to show up for those points. Her tests are a little hard but she provides a good amount of practice problems, those are your best friends for the test. Take her!!!

The lecture videos and in class practice are actually not bad, you'll learn alot and understand the material, however her attitude and demeanor is condescending and just weird. Her tests just have tons of curveballs and are graded inconsistently. The midterms will get progressively harder.

She is a very good professor. She is clear and concise with the work that needs to be done to get an A in the class. BUT she is very sassy and has a ton of attitude, and is sometimes mean/rude. Other than her attitude if you need a good prof for Gen chem just take her.

Doc Mac's lectures are amazing - clear and easy to understand, even with heavy content. I always looked forward to attending her classes and felt like I learned a lot. I would definitely recommend her. I would consider a different instructor if you do not enjoy a highly enthusiastic and energetic teaching style. 8/10

I think she changed how she writes her tests this semester because all of the good reviews are old. I Q-dropped because I knew her class was going to be hell, but I came back to say DON'T TAKE HER. It doesn't matter who you are, you will lose your precious 4.0

If you are an incoming freshman, taking 119. TAKE MCCARTNEY. She is a very good professor for 119. I thought that would transfer over to 120. I was WRONG. With unbearable tests, her class was HORRIBLE. TAKE SOMEONE ELSE.

Pretty straightforward class. Tests were comparatively harder than 119, but if you put in the work outside of class, the results come. ALEKS sucks so get started before the due date. Doc Mac is a fantastic professor, but she often stops class when there's extra talking (in a room of 500+ students). Practice problems during lectures go super slow.

Don't take her. Cried coming out of almost EVERY test. Makes you question if you even want to continue in pre-med. There's difficult classes and there's classes like hers where spending 7 hours everyday on chem isn't even enough to make an A. Just when you think there's hope after that 3rd test, THERE ISN'T, she will humble you with the tests after

DO NOT TAKE HER FOR CHEM 120. Her exams were very difficult for no reason at all and always included questions that we have never seen before. The class averages for the exams were always low and were all free response. It takes a lot of effort and struggle to try and make an A in her class. God be with y'all if you guys take her.

I have never worked so hard to make an A in my life. Exams are incredibly difficult. Somewhat caring prof (in my personal experience) but condescending toward other students. Probably not my first choice but if you work harder than 99% of your classmates you can make an A.

If there is one thing about me, it is that I love chemistry. This class made me hate chemistry. I soon came to realize that my problem was the professor. She doesn't teach. She makes you do everything outside of class. Most exams do NOT match problems we do in class. Half of her class is failing. Do NOT take her! You will regret it.

DO NOT TAKE HER!!! This is by far the worst class I have taken, you think you know the material but that doesn't mean you will get a good grade. The class is deceptively easy. All of the participation problems, homework, and material is relatively easy and understandable. However, all that goes out the window when it comes to the exams.
You can kiss your first semester 4.0 goodbye

I had Professor McCartney for chem 119 & 120. She was great for 119. She provided good resources for studying and a mock exam. However, I would not recommend taking this prof for 120. She did not teach the information we needed to pass her test. Her in-class questions did not prepare you for the exam whatsoever. Class averages on most test very bad

I had Professor McCartney for Chem 119 and absolutely loved her, however, I took her again for Chem 120 and she completely changed. As a 4.0 student, I put so much effort into this class. The notes she taught us in class weren't the full information to be able to perform well on the exams. She was passive aggressive and talked down on her students.

Doo Doo. Barely clutched up on the exams after self studying for the math and then still lost points bc of horrendous conceptual questions we were never prepared for. Only reason she is still at a 3.8 on here is because of the loads of good chem 119 reviews. Horrendous for Chem 120. Avoid her. Good videos but useless practice in class.

Her flipped lecture works in theory but in practice her classes end up completing around 3-4 questions in the entire hour. This seemed like a huge waste of time while the online videos took up a lot of time. The test always had a questions that were formatted in a way that was never presented in practice before which was frustrating.

McCartney is the only Chem-120 professor who did not give any sort of curve or extra credit, for the course despite having mediocre and failing averages. And worst of all she didn't even care about the fact that despite the vast majority of a class of 600+ having horrible scores maybe she could give some sort of aid. Take anyone else if possible.

Doc Mac treats students like 6th graders. mock exams, iclicker, canvas questions, and aleks are NOTHING like the real exam. focuses only math problems when exams are 50% conceptual that no one knows. she does not prepare you well for exams, and does not care about failing or barely passing exam averages. take any other professor for 120

Dr. McCartney makes you watch pre-recorded lecture topic videos and simply goes over practice problems during class. I don't mind this, but the actual classes become boring sometimes. The first three exams before the final were okay, but the fourth one destroyed everyone because many of the problems were the types that no one had ever seen before.

She will always put something on the test that you have no way of studying for even if you've done every single review material given and attended every lecture. It really feels like she wants her students to fail, as she seems completely unconcerned with alarming results and always meets students seeking help with unwarranted and rude sarcasm.

the aleks homework is horrendous. Learning the material is not bad and you'll understand it but the tests have mad curveballs to them, especially conceptual stuff. Every test average is lower than the previous so don't bank on the 4th or final to save ur grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I was excited to have Doc Mac for 120, but I was met with a condescending attitude, constant quizzes and miscalculations on her part, and a complete lack of cooperation with students. Once, she sent spongebob memes in response to the majority of the class failing an exam. This class didn't teach chemistry, it taught me patience (it is running thin)

Take her for 119 if you can, she's good at teaching that. Do NOT take her for 120. Mock exams and lecture practice problems do not reflect the difficulty of exams. She puts the most horrendous conceptual topics on exams which are usually never covered in class. Prides herself on low exam averages and being sassy/having an attitude toward students.

The exams are nothing like any problem you work. When Q drop came around, I had a 77 in the class and planned on Q dropping. I expressed my concern, and she insisted I keep the class. She told me I would do well on the 4th exam. Everyone failed it. The class average was a 63%. My chances at a B were long gone. I wish I Q dropped. DO NOT TAKE HER!!!

Tests are nothing like the lecture, I've asked her multiple times on how to study for her exams and all I got was "life is hard" and further false sympathy. The most recent test average was 63.4 and only 1 student out of 600+ made a 100. I have a 4.0 in all other classes and Dr. McCartney's Chem 120 is not a weed-out class it's a drop-out class.

She simply does not care about her students. It does not matter how much or how long you study for an exam, you will will rarely make an A. Material on test DOES NOT match exam material. She makes jokes when the averages are failing. This is just another paycheck to her. She will take away your love for chemistry and drain you. TAKE ANYONE ELSE!

Content heavy class. Canvas quizzes 3 times a week and homework due twice a week. Lecture exams are super difficult and hard to finish within the given class time. Try to stay on top of the modules or you will fall behind. good luck.

Great at math concepts, HORRIBLE at conceptual; there is virtually no practice beforehand and you get whammed going into the exam. either very passive-aggressive and will treat you like a baby. Prides herself on her failing averages, and videos from her flipped lecture style don't reflect criticism received in the past. Take someone else if able.

I barely got an A in this class and that definitely wasn't because of McCartney. Flipped classroom so she doesnt teach in class. She takes an hour in class to get through 2-4 practice questions. Exams are nothing like the mock exams. No curve, no extra credit, not understanding, horrible class averages. Great for 119 not for 120.TAKE ANYONE ELSE.

Doc Mac skipped class for two weeks following spring break. Her tests are difficult and she refuses to curve. She treats us like toddlers and her class is as if she is beating us in the head with a stick. She believes that poor exam grades are at the fault of students while the reality is that we are not given the adequate tools to prepare.

She was my favorite prof when I took 119, now for 120, she's my least favorite. if you're and average test taker (72-73 range) then YOU WILL NOT GET AN A, maybe a borderline B. If you get all all 600 points for homework/lab/final/iclicker with said averages, there is no physical way for a A. AWFUL TESTS. Couldn't finish in extra time

I think she cares about her students but also doesn't. No curves on any tests so far, with averages in the low 70s, and little help from pre-test review material. I would not suggest taking her at all costs. Also outside of the learning aspect, she's really annoying in class.

If not for the tests this would be an average professor, but Dr. Mac creates the worst tests test I've taken in college. I am very good at chemistry, and these tests will likely make me receive a B in the class. Easy Iclicker questions and unhelpful mock exams are extremely misleading come test time. Every question is formed like a trick question.

McCartney has given incredibly difficult tests this semester in this class. She does not care about grade averages because the majority of them are failing! I dedicate my life to this class and still do not do well on the tests because she always makes the questions about things that weren't covered in class! Good for 119 do NOT TAKE HER FOR 120

The worst professor I have had so far. Not a bad teacher, but has the worst tests that are nothing like the mocks. Chemistry is my best subject and I knew 95% of the material before taking this class and am expecting a B. Adds problems to every test that we had never seen anything like before

Never left a rating, but for this prof I had to. I strongly advise to not listen to the 2 comments below. She does not care test avgs r Cs/failing. Many studious ppl still have had huge problems with unfair tests that are NOTHING like the practice, clicker qs& test review. Please do not take her. Trust me. Other profs will curve & help you out

Doc Mac gives fair tests and really works to set you up for success. It is a flipped classroom so, there is a lot to do outside of class with videos, canvas participation questions, and aleks homework due most days of the week. It can be a lot to manage but if you keep up with the work you will be very prepared for the tests. Definitely recommend!

Horrendous teacher, producing test averages in the low 70's and saying "that's good!". The whole point of being a teacher is to TEACH the students. She teaches in a "flipped-classroom" style, so if you are not willing to spend hours each week watching lecture videos on your own, don't take her. She only does practice problems in actual class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Puts extremely tortured questions on tests and the mock exams do not represent the test difficulty. Also uses reverse classroom teaching, so if that doesn't work for you then do not take McCartney. She also sends 10-15 emails each week and it's kind of annoying. Talks down to students like they are 3rd graders.
She leads the chem department by it's balls. Amazing prof, easy tests and hw, put the work in!

Class is flipped lecture, meaning you will have a lot of videos to watch outside of class on top of the loads of homework she assigns. The mock exams and practice problems are not at all similar to the very difficult exams. Her office hours are helpful and she is a very kind person! However, I would not recommend her if you want a good grade.

Treats students like 6th graders, and lots of homework. Explains topics well, but it is a reverse lecture so not as much is explained in lecture. Tests are mildly difficult, and the mock exams do not help very much. Tons of I-clicker questions. If you are good at chemistry do not take McCartney.

Dr. McCartney is very well versed in Chemistry and explained things well. There is a lot of homework but if you do it all you will do well in the class. The practice exams she gave out before the tests were almost identical to the real tests so make sure to do them.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lecture videos really helped,would take notes before going to class and spent class time to focus on clicker questions.She's pretty tough on due dates but gives partial credit on tests if you show your work.All in all, she explains REALLY well and knows what she's doing.If you put in the time and effort it's possible to get a good grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. McCartney is an excellent professor. I spent 10+ hours a week outside of class doing homework, but it's purposeful and prepared me for OChem. Final: she uses questions on topics that weren't on the test or heavily missed questions. Don't study tests, study notes to see what's missing. Final is hard so she can spread out the grade distributions.

McCartney is a good prof, the hardest part of this class is the lab. It counts for 25% of your grade and the work and grading is questionable. The class itself is not that hard, go to her lectures, do the polling and hw. Always do her exam reviews and practice questions, they're essentially 1 for 1 her exams. This is not a memorization class.

As someone who didn't understand anything in high school chem, Doc Mac was amazing. Flipped classroom where you watch lectures beforehand and do problems in class w explanations. Quick with grading and gives mock exams to study for each exam. However, this class requires A LOT of work with lectures, aleks, labs, and studying for exams.

I would highly recommend Doc Mac. I do well with the flipped-style classroom, but if you don't, that's the only case where I wouldn't recommend her. She is organized, provides helpful mock exams, puts in test grades the same day, & is extremely helpful if you stop by her office hours with a question. Also really funny and wants students to succeed.

The class was taught reverse style where lectures were watched online and practice problems were done in class- which was actually very helpful because you could re-watch the video online if you were confused. Doc Mac is super helpful in answering any questions, homework or lecture related. Would definitely take again!

Doc Mac was pretty good considering I had not taken Chemistry since my junior year of high school and had a weak foundation starting out. I failed a couple tests and still passed the class and would have almost gotten a B if it weren't for the final... (DONT COUNT ON IT!!). Be prepared to dedicate your life to this class
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I would highly recommend her. She's a great professor, and the mock exams are very similar to the actual exams. She gives a lot of homework, but it gives you a strong foundation and base for the future.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The hw is a lot and doesn't always follow a consistent schedule esp if you include the lab assignments. I also found her lecture style a little annoying sometimes. BUT you can tell she cares a lot about her students and about chem and she makes the content very digestible and sets up the class for you to pass and do well on the exams.

Doc Mac was an amazing professor and really knows her stuff. Her exams are open-ended and usually have about 12-16 questions (NOT open note). I bombed the first exam and did well on the rest and came out with a B ,but I did dedicate my life to this class. You should do fine if you're good at managing your time and studying.

She really knows her stuff and sitting in class was enjoyable. She posts online video notes before class and then you do iClicker during class(attendance). Homework is ALEKs and Canvas questions which are totally manageable if you stay on top of it. Some tests were pretty math heavy. I def recommend her for 119.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: She's not only nice but also cares about teaching. She does however have asynchronous lectures, which you need to watch before the face-to-face lectures if you want a good grade. Despite the difficulty and heavy workload, she explains the material extremely well and you learn it through all the work this class requires. Definitely recommend!

She genuinely puts in a lot of effort to make you understand the material. Despite the large class size, I was still able to learn because of her video lectures. Attendence is mandatory because of the iClicker. There is a good amount of work through ALEKS but it helps you genuinely learn before the exams.
She really does care about her students, and shes wicked quick with grading!

McCarthy was amazing. She is such a kind woman and is always willing to work with you on things that you struggle with. Although you need to be in class for points, missing a few lectures will not put you behind. I hiiiighly recommend her.

Dr. McCartney makes you do a lot of work outside of class like watching lecture videos and completing about five assignments each week, but it makes you very well prepared for the exam. She takes attendance during class through iClicker, so make sure to show up to every lecture. Exams are not super difficult and she offers partial credit.
Doc Mac is great and I would take her for any class she offers. The in-class/out-of-class Work is structured very well for LEARNING the material, not just memorizing it.

Doc Mac is a great Prof, I recommend her for any class she is teaching. She really cares about her students and designed the in-class/out-of-class teaching style in a way that really helps you LEARN the material as opposed to just memorize it. If you just try in this class and watch the videos before lecture, it should be easy to get a good grade.

If you put the work in you'll do fine. I made C on one exam/bombed a couple of quizzes and still made an A but I did dedicate my life to the class and would rewatch lectures after the week and redo participation question till you know them because they're essential study tools for exams! Talk to her and go to all office hours!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr McCartney does her best to make this class accessible for everyone. The lecture videos are efficient and to the point and the homework gives plenty of practice. We used Aktiv this semester which was way easier than Aleks. This class was manageable even with others. Don't depend on the final, class average was a 50%. Do good on the first 2 tests.

Extremely organized. Chemistry can be challenging, but Doc Mac has pre-lecture videos, records her lectures, practice problems in class, provides mock exams, and is easily reached. Don't worry if you haven't taken chemistry since sophomore year of high school! DO NOT WAIT UNTIL THE NIGHT BEFORE TO TURN IN A LAB. GO TO CHEM OFFICE HOURS IN HELD 211!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Probably one of the best science profs at A&M. As someone who hated high school chemistry, I was able to do extremely well in both 119 and 120. She gives you clear instructions on what is expected and makes chemistry as easy as possible while still making sure you know the content. Do the mock exams and you'll be just fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Class is very organized and if you watch the prelecture videos and go to class for the practice problems she does you can do very well. I loved her class and took her for 119 as well. If you do all the work and organize yourself you'll be fine. Overall, great professor and I felt like I actually learned a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. McCartney is amazing. She has a flipped classroom style where there are prelecture videos before class, and in class she does practice problems. Her videos are amazing and if you watch those and go to class you'll be fine. Overall, if you do all the work you can get an A in this class and you will actually learn chemistry.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Highly recommend taking Dr. McCartney for CHEM120! It's a tough class, and you'll have to put in many hours outside of class, but she makes it very doable. Her mock exams are usually consistent with the actual exams and she's very accessible and ready to help during office hours. Most of her exams are free-response so you have to know the material!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very outgoing and enthusiastic when she teaches. There's videos to watch before each class & iClicker problems during class. Exams are tough because there is so much to remember how to do, majority free response. I knew how to do each topic individually, but all together, my head was scrambled. There are 2 practice exams before each of the 4 exams.

The only people doing these ratings are the ones who got an A. This class was flipped so you do all your learning & watch lectures outside of class. Tons of ALEKS & canvas questions, and with lab stuff on top of that, you won't have much free time. Tests aren't always like the mock but they're always open ended. I strongly dislike chem but survived

Doc Mac is a great professor! She's caring and I found her office hours very helpful! Her class is flipped which means there's a lot to do outside of class with ALEKS hws, participation q's, and watching lecture videos. I thought her lecture exams were pretty fair but you definitely need to study for them and the final was pretty rough.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's a great prof who explains things very clearly, but she does not hold your hand through this course. her class takes up a lot of time and work, but you have every resource to succeed. The PQ's and mock exams are extremely similar to the exams, so that's super helpful! I'd say Chem 119 is a sure shot with her, but 120 is a lot harder.

I took 107 the previous semester, so I knew about half of the material taught. She assigns recorded lectures to watch, then goes over material in class. The homework is not too bad, but study study study for the exams! Watch the reviews of the practice exams and watch the lecture videos!

I found Dr. McCartney's class very easy. The most important thing you can do to set yourself up for success is to take notes, rewrite your notes, and do the practice tests before exams. Otherwise, I found her very annoying and thought she was very petty and resembled a high-school teacher. Overall: easy class with a flipped classroom design.

This is the first and only time where i felt i benefitted from a flipped classroom. McCartney expects you to be 1000% responsible for yourself, but offers every opportunity for success. i didnt work as hard as i couldve (why i got a B), but she grades fast, sets clear expectations, and provides mock exams. chem is hard, but this is your best shot.

McCartney was a good professor for most of the course, but the final put me below an A. I made Bs on all of my exams before the final and made in A in the lab. However, the average grade for the final was a 60.  Overall, she was not the worst professor but I would take someone else if I could go back. Take her for CHEM 119, not 120.

I loved her! You watch pre-Lecture videos that are long and then you go to class and practice the problems that the videos went over! Test are just like Mocks so do the mocks over and over until you understand! Tests are 13- 14 ques free response but chem 120 is literally all math! The final was MC n quite difficult n she didnt give us a mock!

Great class. Would recommend taking this professor. Flipped classroom was nice. Gave the opportunity to work more problems in class. iClicker questions during class, so I would go to class to get your points. If need extra help, I recommend going to an SI session at least once a week. I wish I had her for 119.

Flipped classroom was well organized. tests were not weighted too heavy, so you could afford an okay grade on a test or two. Gave an opportunity for extra credit on the final and is very transparent about grades. She will show your grade after ever exam, so you should always know where you stand in the class. Lectures were fairly entertaining.

Unless you have taken a AP chem course before, you will struggle in this class. Even a tutor didn't help, the exams are all free response and she says she gives partial credit but she doesn't. She's a great person but the course is very difficult.

Stephanie is conflicting. Her grading criteria makes it to where you can fail a couple tests and still manage an A. However, she uses a flipped classroom style to teach, and tends to overexplain very elementary topics. Only positive is that only 540/1000 of the points in the course are tests. Only take her if you have no chemistry background at all

Class is flip-flop so most of the time you watch videos about topic before lecture and then practice in class except for ALEKS. The test are not worth too much so if you do bad on one, you still have a chance to do well in the class. Attendance is pretty mandatory if you want to do well. Not all information is on the slides!!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Take Dr. McCartney if you are good at chemistry. There is a lot of outside homework and it is a flipped classroom style. The reason she gets a low rating is because she wasn't a nice person. If you asked her a question she made you feel very dumb about it and  talked to us like we were 7. A lot of hw too so watch out. I wouldn't take her again.

The class is very well organized. The exams are almost identical to the mock exam. A lot of outside homework and in class participation that will help carry your grade. This is a flipped classroom so every other day, you will have to spend an hour watching the lecture videos. The exams are math heavy and free response. Lots of partial credit!
Awesome prof but be prepared to work for your grade. Exams are tolerable as she gives plenty of study material. Very kind lady and seems very eager to help when she can. Overall awesome prof
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Chem is hard but McCartney had a firmly structured class. There is a lot of homework (Aleks and daily canvas questions) along with the practice questions done during the lecture. I think she was fair, but the flipped classroom meant lots of work outside of class and dead time during the lecture. She has lots of office hours/ tutoring opportunities

Chem is going to be hard no matter what, but McCartney's class is very organized and she gives lots of practice problems which all help a lot on test. There is a lot of hw, canvas problems, and in class clicker but they all help to boost your overall grade. McCartney responds to emails well but she seemed to be extra agitated this semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Chem is a hard class, but if I had to take someone, it would be McCartney. Lots of work, lots of tears, but you'll make it. Her exams are hard and are mainly free response. Be on your game for her class!!!! For studying do the mock exam over and over again and look briefly over the notes. If you want multiple choice exams, take another teacher.

I love this prof because she is passionate about chemistry and makes sure you understand the material. It is a flipped classroom so you do have to watch videos and put in the work. As long as you participate in class and keep up with the work you are going to do amazing!

Mock exams were very useful for exams. Lots of ALEKS homework and she did flipped classroom so at least 10 PQ's on top of an avg of 10 topics on ALEKS a weeks which can be lengthy and unnecessary. She is repetitious and broke it down step by step; nice and passive aggressive. Take her if you want to understand and have time to do all the homework.

Dr. McCartney is a good professor, the only thing is that her class is A LOT of work. Daily participation, 2x a week homework that can take some time, and there is a lab attached to this class. She is good at teaching and her practice tests are a good measure of what is on the test. Overall for a class like 120 she is probably the best option.

She is soooo funny. Has review sessions for tests. Lecture is very entertaining. Has a flipped classroom. You watch videos before class and then soley work on practice problems during lecture. I love her!

Lots of work outside of class but I like it because practice questions are done in class which allows you to become confident in the material. Do the practice tests and youll be fine for the actual tests
